what_is_it.heading: Iingxaki zeProstate ngokwemiqathango ecacileyo
what_is_it.lede: Idlala lengqula lidlala elincinane elingaphantsi kwesinyi, elibhijelwe kumbhobho womchamo. Ngokwendalo ikhula ngokukhula. Nge-60, amadoda amaninzi ane-prostate yokwandisa. Uninzi lolwandiso lulungile - kodwa kufanelekile ukujongwa.
paragraphs: Izinto ezintathu eziphambili ezinokuhamba kakubi ngedlala lengqula: linokwandisa (BPH—benign prostatic hyperplasia), linokudumba okanye lisuleleke (iprostatitis), okanye linokuba nomhlaza. Zontathu zibangela iimpawu ezifanayo zomchamo.

Umhlaza wedlala lobudoda ngowona mhlaza uxhaphakileyo kumadoda aseMzantsi Afrika. Xa ibanjwe kwangethuba, iyanyangeka kakhulu. Umceli mngeni kukuba amadoda awathethi ngezi mpawu kwaye awayi kujongwa. Ukujongwa ukusuka kwi-50 - okanye i-40 ukuba uMnyama okanye ngembali yosapho - yenye yezona zinto zibalulekileyo ezinokwenziwa yindoda.

items.headline: Ezixhaphake kakhulu
items.body: Umhlaza wedlala lobudoda ngowona mhlaza uxhaphakileyo kumadoda aseMzantsi Afrika. Malunga nomntu omnye kwabasi-8 uya kuyiphuhlisa ebomini bakhe.

items.headline: Qala nge50
items.body: Uvavanyo lonyaka ukusuka kwiminyaka engama-50 - okanye ukusuka kuma-40 ukuba ungumntu omnyama okanye unembali yosapho yomhlaza wedlala lesinyi.

items.headline: Kwangoko = unyangekile
items.body: Umhlaza wedlala lobudoda kwangethuba unama-95% iminyaka emi-5 yokusinda. Ukubanjwa emva kwexesha, ukusinda kwehla ngokukhawuleza. Umahluko kukuhlola.

items.headline: Uninzi alungomhlaza
items.body: Uninzi lweempawu zokuchama kumadoda amadala zibangelwa kukukhula kakuhle, hayi umhlaza. Kodwa awukwazi ukuxelela ngaphandle kokujonga.

pull_quote.text: Amadoda aMnyama aseMzantsi Afrika aphantse aphinda kabini umngcipheko womhlaza wedlala lobudoda kumadoda amhlophe kubomi babo bonke, kwaye asoloko ebonisa amancinci ngezifo ezindlongondlongo. Ukuhlolwa ukusuka kwi-40 - hayi i-50 - ngumnxeba ofanelekileyo wamadoda aMnyama.

signs.heading: Yintoni omawuyijonge
signs.lede: Uninzi lweempawu zedlala lobudoda zivela kukwanda kwe-benign (BPH). Kwaezo mpawu zingakhomba kumhlaza, usulelo, okanye ezinye iimeko. Zihlole.

items.title: Ukutshintsha komchamo
items.description: Umjelo obuthathaka, kufuneka utyhale, ugxadazelisa ekugqibeleni, ukuva ukuba isinyi asinanto, ukuvuka izihlandlo ezininzi ebusuku, ngequbuliso kufuneka uhambe.

items.title: Intlungu okanye igazi
items.description: Ukutshisa xa uchama (usulelo olunokwenzeka ngakumbi), igazi kumchamo okanye amadlozi - kufuna uvavanyo olukhawulezileyo. Isenokuba lusulelo, i-BPH, okanye umhlaza.

items.title: Iimpawu zesilumkiso zamva
items.description: Iintlungu zethambo (ngokukodwa emva okanye ezinqeni), ukulahleka kwesisindo esingenakuchazwa, ukukhathala, ukuvuvukala kwemilenze - kunokubonisa isifo esiphezulu. Bonana nogqirha ngaphandle kokulibazisa.

items.myth: Ukuba ndiyakwazi ukuchama, i-prostate yam ilungile.
items.fact: Amadoda amaninzi anomhlaza wedlala lobudoda anomchamo oqhelekileyo ngokupheleleyo - ngakumbi kumanqanaba okuqala xa unyango lusebenza ngcono. Ukuhlola, kungekhona iimpawu, kuyayibamba kwangethuba.
Uviwo luthatha imizuzwana engama-30 kwaye alukhululekanga, alubuhlungu. Uvavanyo lwegazi lwe-PSA yintonga yenaliti. Zombini zingongeza iminyaka eyi-15+ kubomi bakho.
Unyango lwangoku lungcono kakhulu ekugcineni ukusebenza kunangaphambili. Imiphumo emibi iyahluka ngokwenqanaba kunye nokhetho lonyango. Thetha kwi-urologist yakho - hayi i-intanethi.

items.myth: Sisifo sexhego — ndimncinci kakhulu ukuba ndingakhathazeka.
items.fact: Umhlaza weProstate ungenzeka ukusuka kwiminyaka engama-40, ngakumbi kumadoda aMnyama okanye abo banembali yosapho. Isikhokelo esisemgangathweni samaqela asemngciphekweni ophezulu sivavanya ukusuka kuma-40.

prevention.heading: Indlela yokunciphisa umngcipheko kwaye uyibambe kwangoko
prevention.lede: Umhlaza wedlala lobudoda awunakuthintelwa ngokupheleleyo, kodwa unokuwunciphisa umngcipheko kwaye uwubambe kwangoko. Imiba yokuphila; Ukuhlolwa kubaluleke ngakumbi.

items.title: Uvavanyo lonyaka ukusuka kwi-50
items.description: Uvavanyo lwegazi lwe-PSA kunye novavanyo lwedijithali lwe-rectal. Isimahla kuyo nayiphi na ikliniki karhulumente. Yonyaka ukusuka 50 - okanye 40 ukuba Black, imbali yosapho, okanye ingozi yofuzo eyaziwayo.

items.title: Ukutya kweMeditera
items.description: Imifuno, utamatisi ophekiweyo (i-lycopene), intlanzi, ioli yeoli, i-legumes. Inyama ebomvu encinci kunye nobisi. Idityaniswe nomngcipheko ophantsi womhlaza wedlala lesidlala kuphando.

items.title: Hambisa rhoqo
items.description: Amadoda asebenzayo anezinga eliphantsi lomhlaza wedlala lesidlala kunye neziphumo ezingcono ukuba zifunyenwe. Imizuzu engama-30 yomsebenzi ophakathi iintsuku ezininzi. Ukubala ukuhamba.

items.title: Ubunzima obunempilo
items.description: Ukutyeba kakhulu kunxulunyaniswa nomhlaza wedlala lesinyi kunye neziphumo ezibi. Gcina ubunzima obunempilo, ngakumbi esinqeni.

items.title: Ukuba uneminyaka engama-50 okanye ngaphezulu (40+ kumngcipheko ophezulu)
items.description: Bhukisha uvavanyo lwedlala lobudoda kuyo nayiphi na ikliniki karhulumente. Uvavanyo lwegazi lwe-PSA kunye novavanyo. Mahala. Ukuphinda ngonyaka. Thatha umhlobo ukuba uyakunceda uhambe.

items.title: Ukuba uneempawu zokuchama - zihlole
items.description: Musa 'ukuyilinda'. Uninzi lwezizathu ziyanyangeka, kuquka nomhlaza ukuba ufunyenwe kwangoko. Utyelelo lwasekliniki lukunika iimpendulo, hayi intelekelelo.

items.title: Ukuba iPSA iphakanyisiwe
items.description: Ungothuki — oonobangela abaninzi ayingomhlaza (usulelo, i-BPH, nokukhwela ibhayisekile kutshanje). Ugqirha wakho uya kwenza amalungiselelo ovavanyo olongezelelweyo ukuba luyafuneka.

items.title: Ukuba ufunyanisiwe - yiya kwiqela le-urology
items.description: Amaziko omhlaza kwizibhedlele ezinkulu anamaqela achwephesha ngomchamo. I-CANSA inceda ukuhamba. Ukhetho oluninzi lukhona-kuquka ukulinda umhlaza okhula kade.

items.title: Xelela oonyana bakho nabantakwenu
items.description: Umhlaza wedlala lobudoda unecandelo lemfuzo. Ukuba unayo, izalamane zamadoda kufuneka zihlolwe kwangethuba - ngokuqhelekileyo iminyaka eyi-10 ngaphambi kweminyaka yakho yokuxilongwa.

get_help.heading: Masiye phi
get_help.lede: Ukuhlolwa nokunyangwa kwedlala lobudoda kusimahla kwiikliniki nasezibhedlele zikarhulumente. Eyona nto inzima kukuqalisa incoko. Nje ukuba uyenzile, inkqubo ithatha inkathalo ngokuseleyo.

helplines.description: Uvavanyo lwePSA lwasimahla kunye novavanyo lwedlala lobudoda kuzo zonke iikliniki zikarhulumente
